summary: Tested type-driven Discovery Dashboard end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed for POST /api/aws/discover, GET /api/aws/tag-options, tag filtering (key+value and key-only), auth guard, and resource details shape (ec2_instance/security_group/ebs_volume/route53_zone/a_record with details+tags). Frontend: login, 5 type cards render with correct testids and counts (EC2=5, SG=5, Vol=0, R53=1, A=54, total 65 matches curl), default EC2 view shows table with private_ip column, HoverCard popup on res-hover-0 reveals full details grid + tag chips, type card clicks switch discovery-table correctly, discover-tag-key/value dropdowns populate from tag-options, Discover with Role=slave filters correctly and card counts remain unchanged (all 65 resources carry Role=slave — confirmed via backend data), DEMO MODE badge visible.
critical_code_review_comments: aws_discovery.py _collect_resources duplicates ec2_instance emission logic between inventory and db_config — could extract a helper, but not blocking.

Dashboard.jsx count summary '65 total' comes from filtered response `s.total`, which is what the filter bar displays; the type-card counts also reflect the filtered result (by design). Working as expected.

Volumes card shows 0 because current inventory has no ebs_volumes and no k8s clusters seeded — this is data-driven, not a code bug. If user expects Volumes >0, main agent should either seed volumes or note in UI.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing inventory (5 hosts, all Role=slave).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discovery Dashboard fully verified. Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_discovery_dashboard.py is reusable.
